role: ABSTRACT BASE (supporting context, not a primary in-scope target)
purpose: Abstract base for yield-strategy adapters. Provides Ownable + ReentrancyGuard + Pausable, an EnumerableSet of authorized clients, authorized withdrawers, per-client setAsideBuffer, a two-phase (24h wait / 48h window) totalWithdrawal migration flow, emergencyWithdraw, and the skimSurplus orchestration. Concrete strategies (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy) override _emergencyWithdraw / _totalWithdraw / _skimSurplus / deposit / withdraw.

stateVariables.name: _authorizedClients
stateVariables.invariant: distinct membership (set) -> skimSurplus cannot over-skim via duplicate clients (M-01 structural fix)

stateVariables.name: setAsideBufferSize
readers: _accrueSurplusShares (PERCENT 0-100, note: units differ from slippage BPS)

externalEntryPoints.notes: documented accepted economic quirk: a client front-running a skim with a fresh deposit raises its surplus share and thus its self-set-aside; accepted because clients are protocol-owned and principal is untouched

phase1 caches balanceOf at initiation; phase2 (after 24h, within 48h window) calls _executeWithdrawal -> _totalWithdraw; resets state before the external call (reentrancy-safe ordering); CANNOT run while paused
passes the on-strategy _authorizedClients.values() into _skimSurplus (caller cannot supply a client list -> closes duplicate over-skim); empty set is a no-op returning 0

reentrancyNotGuarded: emergencyWithdraw (onlyOwner; concrete impl only moves shares to owner)
verifiedProperties.twoPhaseWithdrawalOrdering: verified: _executeWithdrawal zeroes state BEFORE calling _totalWithdraw (effects before interaction)
verifiedProperties.skimClientListNotCallerSupplied: verified (M-01 mitigation): client set is read from on-chain EnumerableSet

trustAssumptions: Owner is trusted/non-malicious (Law 3). Owner controls client/withdrawer/buffer/pauser config and the emergency + migration paths.
Pauser is a trusted Global Pauser contract.
Two-phase totalWithdrawal (24h+48h) is the anti-rug delay; note totalWithdrawal is whenNotPaused, so a paused contract blocks even legitimate migration until unpaused.

supportingFindings.description: setAsideBufferSize is a PERCENT (0-100) while slippageToleranceBps is BPS (0-10000). Mixing the two mental models is an owner footgun (e.g. passing 50 expecting 0.5%). Both are owner-gated and documented but the inconsistency is worth noting.

totalWithdrawal carries whenNotPaused. If the Global Pauser pauses the strategy, the emergency migration path is blocked until unpause. emergencyWithdraw (no pause gate) remains available to owner, so this is a degraded-availability note, not a lockup.

scannerNotes: Surplus/skim math lives partly here (orchestration) and partly in the concrete (_skimSurplus). Treat the concrete ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy profile as authoritative for realized value.

_initiateWithdrawal caches this.balanceOf (principal for the market strategy) at phase 1; the cached value is passed to phase 2 but the concrete _totalWithdraw re-reads clientBalances live and uses THAT (clientStoredBalance), so a balance change between phases is honored by the concrete, not the cache.
